messages:
ana_cs: Heads-up from today's sync with Fulcrum AI—they're planning org-wide tools (search + contracts assistant) and expect ~4 squads onboarding in 5 weeks. Projected steady usage ~900k tokens/day and embeddings ~40k/week. Renewal in ~75 days; procurement wants region support and cost predictability.

lee_eng: any request size or peak window? are they testing long-context models?

ana_cs: interactive calls ~250-500 tokens. daily morning ingest spike around 08:00 UTC. Legal wants 10k-context trials for some flows. They asked for EU hosting and per-team quotas.

sam_pm: recommend a dedicated pilot in eu-central with per-team quotas. Need capacity profile, simple pilot config, cost bands, and an enablement plan. Can eng draft a sizing by EOD?

lee_eng: quick calc: 900k/350~2570 req/day => ~1.5 rps avg; observed spikes ~6x -> peak ~9 rps. With long contexts suggest sizing for 20-25 rps headroom. Need p95 latency target from customer.

kai_success: i'll set an enablement workshop for next Tue, collect logs and exact team list. Also capture retry storm details.

marta_fin: we can supply per-team breakdowns and a single invoice. I'll draft committed vs PAYG bands once eng posts sizing.

ingest-bot: "upload: fulcrum_30d_usage.csv"

lee_eng: got CSV; will post capacity sim and recommended kernel/quant choices by EOD.

sam_pm: owners: lee->sizing, marta->pricing bands, kai->workshop, ana->confirm SLO wording. Aim to present pilot within 4 business days. :spiral_calendar_pad:
